title: Hanford assigns one human-reviewed resolution action to every required field
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: 12 field actions distinguish absent, incompatible, authority-mismatched, period-mismatched, privacy-gated, not-yet-evaluated, and present states without automated closure. Denominator: 12 field actions across 1 playbook.
key_findings: Finding: 12 field actions distinguish absent, incompatible, authority-mismatched, period-mismatched, privacy-gated, not-yet-evaluated, and present states without automated closure.
Boundary: No action closes a field automatically.
Boundary: Values cannot migrate across records.
Boundary: Human publication review remains mandatory.
Next action: Apply the exact action only when a candidate record enters the corresponding queue.
why_it_matters: The record turns a reopening contract into a field-explicit intake control without creating a readiness score or implying that a candidate record exists.
ftfn_relevance: Classifies all sixty Phase 57K contract fields.
Defines the first record eligible for human review on every held rail.
Assigns one explicit resolution action to each field while preventing cross-record value assembly.
evidence_limits: Not publicly acquired does not mean nonexistent, withheld, or never submitted.
